pictures.name: pd_patinir_sodoma

pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, Cliffs of the Upper Colorado River — the river running full through the dry red cliffs, He turns a desert into pools of water
pictures.name: pd_moran_colorado

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the city standing on its hill in the morning light, that they may establish a city in which to dwell
pictures.name: pd_church_jerusalem

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Red Vineyard at Arles — the pickers bending along the blazing rows with their baskets, they plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest
pictures.name: pd_gogh_wijngaard

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, View on a Plain — the shepherd with his staff among the resting cattle and sheep, He does not let their herds diminish
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_vlakte

pictures.scene: James Tissot, The Flight of the Prisoners — the column of captives carrying their bundles out of the burning city, decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow
pictures.name: pd_tissot_ballingschap

pictures.scene: Jacques-Louis David, Belisarius Begging for Alms — the great general blind and holding out his helmet at the roadside, He pours out contempt on the nobles
pictures.name: pd_david_belisarius

pictures.scene: Giovanni Segantini, Ave Maria a trasbordo — the whole flock and the mother and child carried across the water in the evening light, He increases their families like flocks
pictures.name: pd_segantini_avemaria

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Triumph of the Church over Fury, Discord and Hate — the Church raised up with the monstrance while the accuser is thrown down silent beneath the wheel, all iniquity shuts its mouth
pictures.name: pd_rubens_zegewagen

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Philosopher in Meditation — the old man sitting still with folded hands by the window and the open book, let him who is wise pay heed to these things
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_filosoof

lines.text: He turns rivers into deserts,
springs of water into thirsty ground,
and fruitful land into fields of salt,
because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
He turns a desert into pools of water
and a dry land into flowing springs.
He causes the hungry to settle there,
that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
They sow fields and plant vineyards
that yield a fruitful harvest.
He blesses them, and they multiply greatly;
He does not let their herds diminish.
When they are decreased and humbled
by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
He pours out contempt on the nobles
and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
But He lifts the needy from affliction
and increases their families like flocks.
The upright see and rejoice,
and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
Let him who is wise pay heed to these things
and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
